scope: Code and local-runtime release validation. Public deployment acceptance is documented separately in DEPLOYMENT.md.

nodeBrowser.command: npm run build && E2E_PRODUCTION=1 npm run test:e2e

cloudflare.runtime: workerd / Miniflare with SQLite Durable Objects
coverage: full friend match, deterministic replay, rematch and restart
real alarm timeout without client polling
local record reconstruction and custom-offer recompilation
concurrent ready and idempotent command submission

boundaries.staticGuest: 1440px and 390px UI walkthrough blocks all API requests, verifies zero API requests, resumes after refresh, and removes finished temporary state.
boundaries.accountUI: Uses deterministic engine positions and controlled transport fixtures. Backend behavior is independently verified by the Cloudflare suite.
boundaries.nodeBrowser: Uses real HTTP/WebSocket for service paths, with deterministic engine fixtures for timing-sensitive presentation cases.
boundaries.fullscreen: Checks gesture request and rejection fallback with browser fixtures; not a claim of physical-device native fullscreen coverage.
boundaries.publicNetwork: See DEPLOYMENT.md; local suites are not public-network load tests.
